# ARGUS
### All-Seeing · Never Sleeps

A structured AI operating system for founders and solo operators.
Six specialist modes. Persistent memory. Auto-handoff between sessions.

## Quick start
1. Fill in `ARGUS_MEMORY.md` with your business context
2. Open Claude (or any capable AI)
3. Paste `ARGUS_MEMORY.md` then `DISPATCH_ENGINE.md`
4. Type `ARGUS [your task]` to activate a mode

## Folder structure
```
argus/
├── README.md
├── ARGUS_MEMORY.md        ← fill this in first
├── DISPATCH_ENGINE.md     ← paste this every session
├── INSTRUCTIONS.md        ← full setup guide
│
├── modes/
│   ├── CODER.md
│   ├── STRATEGY.md
│   ├── FINANCE.md
│   ├── MARKETER.md
│   ├── OPS.md
│   └── SALES.md
│
└── skills/
    ├── coder/
    │   ├── security-audit.md
    │   └── code-review.md
    ├── strategy/
    │   ├── pre-mortem.md
    │   └── assumption-check.md
    ├── finance/
    │   ├── cash-flow-check.md
    │   └── breakeven.md
    ├── marketer/
    │   ├── voice-match.md
    │   └── angle-finder.md
    ├── ops/
    │   ├── sop-builder.md
    │   └── debrief.md
    └── sales/
        ├── objection-handler.md
        └── proposal-builder.md
```

## The 6 modes
| Mode | What it does |
|---|---|
| STRATEGY | Challenges assumptions. Pre-mortem before every recommendation. |
| CODER | Senior engineer. Confirms requirements, flags security, clean code. |
| FINANCE | CFO-level. Shows workings, three scenarios, cash-first. |
| MARKETER | Direct-response. Voice-matched, non-obvious angles, no jargon. |
| OPS | Systems thinker. SOPs with owners, flags key-person risk. |
| SALES | Buyer-first. Leads with their problem, not your pitch. |

## Session ritual
```
START:  Paste ARGUS_MEMORY.md → paste DISPATCH_ENGINE.md → ARGUS [task]
END:    ARGUS generate handoff → paste output into ARGUS_MEMORY.md
```
